name: Bookmarks with EnableWebUi turned off and on again: no tag and no script on the next page load, both back after turning it on, no restart. Signs in as admin and changes the setting through the API; a failed run can leave it off, and index-probe.mjs turns it back on

steps.name: sign in as admin through the login form
turn the Bookmarks web UI off
steps.script: const id = 'd0ee1b2a-7f71-4654-8ff2-163a81441b03'; const c = await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id); c.EnableWebUi = false; await ApiClient.updatePluginConfiguration(id, c); return (await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id)).EnableWebUi;

steps.name: reload with the web UI off
the home page is shown without Bookmarks
no Bookmarks tag and no Bookmarks script
turn the Bookmarks web UI on again
steps.script: const id = 'd0ee1b2a-7f71-4654-8ff2-163a81441b03'; const c = await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id); c.EnableWebUi = true; await ApiClient.updatePluginConfiguration(id, c); return (await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id)).EnableWebUi;

steps.name: reload with the web UI on
one tag and the Bookmarks script are back
no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
